contract: Pre-authored vector pose frames, NOT articulated skeletal rigs. Frame selection only; stable foot/pivot and facing root transform. No collision data authored here.
geometryContract: baseHeight128 and viewBox remain common; never fit each pose/growth stage to the same visual height. Movement footprint and targetable/hit geometry are unset and simulation-owned. VisualBounds include arms/fan; bodyCoreArtGuide is non-authoritative art metadata only.

fallbacks.transition: select prepare → attack/link → recover → idle from simulation state, never invent combat actions in animation
fallbacks.facing: root scaleX sign only; no reflow or foot recenter per state

sourceProvenance.referenceAndRawSVG: Retained outside gameplay bundle in authoring archive; original textured direction retained, flat selected explicitly.
sourceProvenance.method: Generated approved-direction references → actual Inkscape object-trace → real path-simplify and semantic boolean intersection/difference/union → absolute command normalization. No code-invented character polygons.

budgetDecision.scope: Exactly these16 immutable IDs/hashes only. Global350-anchor gate unchanged.
budgetDecision.requiredRemainingGate: Actual stage9/24 desktop/mobile visual + frame-cost comparison; microbenchmark CPU is not FPS approval.
